name: AURELIA Core
description: The active AURELIA cognitive engine: a distributed, self-healing platform for enterprise-scale infrastructure management.

name: Recursive Cognition
description: Research into bounded recursive cognition — the modeling techniques that underpin AURELIA's constrained learning loops.

name: Global Nexus Grid
description: The routing and datacenter fabric that AURELIA is deployed across, spanning 42 global datacenters.

name: Dynamic Memory Allocator
description: Memory management and allocation subsystems for AURELIA Core, including allocation diagnostics and anomaly instrumentation.

name: Zero-Trust Protocol
description: Company-wide zero-trust boundary protocol enforcing authentication on every inter-node process, even those spawned by AURELIA.

name: Project ECHO
description: Suspended theoretical-research program into cognitive resonance in unbounded systems. Assets moved to cold storage in 2018.

name: System Archives
description: Retention and cold-storage program for decommissioned subsystems and legacy repositories.

name: AURELIA Alpha Line
description: Sealed precursor line to AURELIA, developed under Advanced Research prior to the current architecture. Records are retained for lineage continuity only.
